check_selectors: check the integrity of selectors for empty readers, invalid types, and duplicate labels
limit_selectors_group_size: limit the group sizes in selectors to a maximum group size by splitting oversized groups
pad_selectors: pad empty readers to ensure each example has the same number of readers
pad_rankings: pad rankings and groups to a fixed number of readers and return shaped arrays
repeat_selectors: repeat every reader in selectors a specified number of times
